traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for Story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are fully met.
- **Before/After/Mixed Positions**: Implemented in `processCommentLine` with `isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine` and verified by dedicated valid cases in `tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts`. - **Proper Termination & Boundary Detection**: `isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine` treats any `@word` JSDoc tag other than traceability tags as a boundary. `processCommentLine` finalizes the pending annotation when such a boundary is hit, preventing concatenation of `@param`/`@returns` into story/req values. - **Continuation Logic & Preserve Multiline**: Continuations only occur when there is a pending annotation and the next normalized line is non-empty and not a JSDoc tag; multi-line examples confirm story and req values are preserved correctly without including subsequent tags. - **No False Positives & Error Messages**: The regression described in Issue #3 is explicitly covered by `[REQ-NO-FALSE-POSITIVES]` test, which now passes without error. Existing invalid-format tests continue to produce clear, targeted error messages, indicating no new false positives were introduced. - **Backward Compatibility**: All existing tests for prior stories (005.0, 007.0, 010.1, 010.2, etc.) pass alongside the new coexistence tests, showing previous valid annotations continue to work as before. - **Documentation**: The rule documentation includes a JSDoc coexistence section with an example referencing this story, explaining the exact behavior required.
Given the concrete implementation, comprehensive targeted tests, passing test suite, and updated documentation, the story is fully implemented and verified.
